fact: Telecom Namibia says it is laying new long-distance fibre routes giving redundant paths between key cities and regions, and enhancing its fibre backbone networks; no contract, length or route is given.

The ICT Minister told the National Assembly that Namibia's fibre optic network stretches to 18,719.5 km, with regional lengths given for //Karas (3,340.48 km), Otjozondjupa (2,624.34 km), Erongo (2,547.72 km), Hardap (2,232.11 km), Khomas (1,775.97 km), Zambezi (571.72 km), Kavango West (544.84 km) and Omusati (539.52 km); the speech does not call it a backbone or say who owns it, and the date is the speech date.
